verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes a first-party docs page titled "Bits AI" (docs.datadoghq.com/bits_ai/), which points to a built-in AI assistant inside Datadog. The pack contains only the title, with no content showing what it does or that users can delegate tasks to it. Missing for 10: documented description of the assistant's capabilities, evidence of task delegation or agentic actions inside the product, and hands-on or community corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
